description: Source test file for Playwright's test-step reporting, containing test cases and reporter implementation for verifying step hierarchy, error handling, and fixture behavior during tests.

classes.name: MyReporter
classes.description: Custom Playwright Reporter class for detailed step and error reporting during tests.

methods.name: formatPrefix
methods.description: Formats the prefix string for displaying steps.

methods.name: formatLocation
methods.description: Formats the location object into a string with file basename and line number.

methods.name: formatStack
methods.description: Formats a raw stack trace with indentation, filtering only specific lines.

methods.name: printErrorLocation
methods.description: Boolean property to control whether error locations are printed.

methods.name: skipErrorMessage
methods.description: Boolean property to control whether error messages are suppressed.

methods.name: trimError
methods.description: Trims the error message based on skipErrorMessage setting.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called when test suite begins; stores suite info.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Outputs data to stdout, for debugging.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Outputs data to stderr, for debugging.

methods.name: printStep
methods.description: Prints a detailed representation of a test step, including nested steps and errors.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Processes suite results and outputs summaries after tests complete.
